summary: Mobile V1 (Expo web preview) frontend testing complete. All requested flows PASSED: login renders correctly (no blank/white screen), invalid creds show Turkish error 'Kullanıcı adı veya şifre hatalı' and stay on /login, valid serkan/19071987 login navigates to /tasks. Tasks screen loads 17 tasks under 3 category sections (Fason Verme 2/5, Kargolama 0/0, Kategorisiz 1/12) with correct done/total roll-ups and header count 'GÖREVLER · 3/17 tamamlandı'. Task toggle round-trip works (PATCH /api/tasks/{id}) — pill switches Bekliyor↔Tamamlandı and strikethrough appears. Expand-all/collapse-all correctly show/hide all task rows (17↔0 visible). Bottom tab navigation to PROFİL works, profile shows username 'serkan' and role 'Yönetici', logout button returns to /login. testIDs align with request. Minor: search with a no-match query still renders empty category headers instead of the empty state (empty state only triggers when there are zero categories, not when categories have zero filtered tasks) — cosmetic UX. Two React Native web deprecation console warnings observed ('shadow*' style props deprecated → use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated) — non-blocking.

issues: Search that matches zero tasks still shows all category headers (each with 0 rollup) rather than the 'Sonuç bulunamadı' empty state. Consider hiding categories whose rollup.total === 0 during an active search, or fall back to the empty state when no task rows are rendered. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx (nodes memo + empty branch condition).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Likely emitted from login button shadow* props. Reference: /app/mobile/app/login.tsx:190-194 (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset). Migrate to boxShadow for RN Web / RN 0.76+.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Origin appears internal (Expo Router / RN Web), but confirm none of your own components pass pointerEvents as a prop; move to style.pointerEvents if any are found.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Improve search UX on /tasks — either hide categories with rollup.total === 0 during search or show the tasks-empty-state when no tasks match. File: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx.
Replace deprecated shadow* style props on the login button with boxShadow to silence the RN Web deprecation warning. File: /app/mobile/app/login.tsx (styles.button).
Audit for any props.pointerEvents usage in mobile source and migrate to style.pointerEvents (currently no direct hit found in review; warning may be third-party).
critical_code_review_comments: expo-linear-gradient replacement with solid View works correctly on web preview — login no longer blank.
TasksScreen.onToggleExpand toggles via 'prev[id] === false' pattern which correctly treats undefined as open by default — behavior verified via expand/collapse-all round trip.
buildTaskTree correctly rolls up done/total including nested children; observed 2/5 + 0/0 + 1/12 = 3/17 which matches header total 3/17.
Optimistic update in onToggleTask reverts on ApiError — good; also handles 401 via handleUnauthorized → logout.
testIDs on all interactive elements match request spec (login-*, tasks-*, task-toggle-*, tasks-category-header-*, profile-*, logout-button).
